title: Understanding PCA
text: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to emphasize variation and bring out strong patterns in a dataset. It reduces the dimensionality of the data while preserving as much variance as possible.

title: Reconstruction Error in PCA
text: The reconstruction error in PCA is the error between the original data and the data reconstructed from the principal components. Using more principal components generally reduces the reconstruction error.
